title: Drive Avatars, Multi-Screen Rosters & Stability Update (v0.4.14)
message: Includes Google Drive avatar upload & caching, teacher photo moderation, student photo removal, rounded squircle avatars across all rosters, Help Center role filters, and A24 stability fixes.
changelog:
• Google Drive Avatar Upload: Profile pictures upload directly to Google Drive with high-speed CDN streaming.
• Zero-Latency Avatar Caching: Two-tier memory and disk caching eliminates placeholder loading flickers.
• Visual Photo Moderation: Teachers can preview and zoom submitted student photos before approving.
• Student Avatar Controls: Added option to remove/reset profile picture; locked teacher avatar editing.
• Universal Squircle Avatars: Rounded borders applied across Profile, Class Roster, Section Roster, and Performance Analytics.
• Role-Filtered Help Center: Student account locks to student guides; teachers retain access to all guides.
• Samsung A24 Stability: Safely handles expired picker content URIs to prevent app crashes.
• Instant Accessibility Screen Capture & Apprentice Quest Completion Banners.
